interpretation: Checklist credits existing teaching and describes new authored depth against named scope ranges. It is not an exhaustive fact-verification certificate or evidence that a learner completed a WSET qualification.
Every new KI remains unverified. last_verified_at records actual UTC curation, not expert verification. valid_from is2026-10-02 so local publication must include that date.

Original cases supply fictional data and conditional four-role self-review. One case illustrates a range; it does not establish mastery of every real-world situation. Explicit conceptual teaching plus existing anchors and wider writing exercises must be considered together.
No WSET proprietary examination question or prose is copied. WSET specification is a scope source only; facts cite independent primary sources.
NoGit/CI/Android changes were made by this subagent; root owns integration andvalidation.
